name: catalog_search
description: Search the evidence catalogue with a regex: a disk's filelist, timeline, bodyfile, fsstat or partitions, or an archive's members; or list the catalogue's generations (which=generations: what each is, over what object, complete or partial and why, its readable form). Returns the match count, one page (limit, offset) and the catalogue revision it read. When the page is not all of them, every match is kept in a file under your scratch and named (all_matches).

which.description: filelist|timeline|bodyfile|fsstat|partitions (a disk), members (an archive's member list), or generations (the catalogue's generations; pattern filters them)

limit.description: Matching lines to return in this call (default 50); the count is always of all of them

offset.description: Skip this many matches first, to page through a result (next_offset gives the next page)

catalog.description: The catalogue: its directory under catalog/ as the index names it, or a generation id (g0003) from a revision; default: the only one there is

partition.description: The filesystem's directory in the catalogue, p<first sector> (e.g. p2048), when there is more than one (default: the only one)

revision.description: The catalogue revision to read (catalog/revisions/<n>/, as a post announces it); default: the newest complete one
